fullDesc: In July 1979 Sony released the Walkman, a portable cassette player with headphones. It changed how people listened to music and sold over 200 million units across its versions.
realFacts: Co-founder Masaru Ibuka wanted to hear opera on flights
The first model cost around 150 dollars
Cassettes were later replaced by CDs and MP3s
It paved the way for the iPod
